modelNotes: Futures Super Finals and US Club Championships are weighted as peer major events for girls groups.
Teams that played both events receive higher confidence but not automatic ranking priority.
Common-opponent crossover is considered across Futures, US Club, JO Qualifiers, SD County Cup, and other verified events.
Division-tier guardrails keep D1 teams above most D2 teams unless lower-division teams have direct support.
A/B/C team-depth guardrails are applied before publication.
Same-team aliases were manually normalized for common 12U Girls naming variants.
Teams with fewer than five tracked games are held from the public ranking.
7.12 v3 manual review moved SBWPC A out of the top 10 because its best major-event finish came in Futures D2 and its D1 evidence did not justify a top-10 placement.
